propositions: Provider construction logic is currently inline in run() as a special case branch checking for anthropic provider, with no centralized registry or factory pattern for adding new providers
Client teardown (httpx.AsyncClient) requires manual finally-block cleanup in run(), creating a resource lifecycle management problem that will not scale to multiple provider implementations
pydantic-ai's infer_model(provider_factory=...) hook expects a (str) -> Provider callable, but the current Anthropic builder returns a (model, client) tuple, preventing use of the upstream hook

Introducing ProviderSession as a context manager that owns the provider factory callable and manages closeables lifecycle will enable sealing this seam before adding Bedrock and OpenAI-compatible providers as additive registrations
Tests importing _build_retrying_anthropic_model directly from rebar.llm.runner must migrate to importing from rebar.llm.anthropic_model after the relocation
The refactored design must demonstrate that run() obtains providers through the session factory and that all constructed clients are closed both on normal return and on exception
